notes: The approved engine for a supported Omaweb build. A build below any of
these versions is an unsupported preview and says so at runtime.
`chromiumSecurityPatch` is the Chromium release whose security fixes the
approved QtWebEngine carries, which is what a security baseline is
written against; `chromium` is only the release it is built on.
scripts/check_security_baseline.py compares this against upstream weekly.
Raising it is the last step of a security response: see SECURITY.md.
